summary: Dashboard reworked to 3 views in public/graph.html. FRONTIER (default; replaces Flow, localStorage 'flow'→'frontier' migrated): dagre over a subset = live seeds (ready/in_progress/failed/tested/not_ready) + all 1-hop neighbors + upward ancestry (blocking deps always to root; context deps only if weight>=0.5 or top-3 per node, recursive, capped ~4 hops); context edges render weight-scaled (width 1+1.5w, opacity 0.3+0.6w); excluded connected nodes live in a collapsed "N hidden" chip bar (#flowhidden), deg-0 nodes stay in the Independent tray; zero-live fallback = 15 most-recently-changed. FOCUS: one node's full ancestry+descendants, entered via "⌖ Focus" button in the detail panel (focusNode(key)); third toggle button hidden until focused; focusedId kept across view switches, never persisted. CLOUD untouched. Key interfaces for future tasks: buildLinks(d)→{tasks,byId,links[{from,to,kind,w}]} (blocking/context from task fields ONLY — daemon folds overlay edges in; d.edges used solely for supersede), frontierSelect(tasks,links,byId)→Set, focusSelect(links,id)→Set, renderDagSubset(view,nodes,links,byId) shared dagre pipeline with per-view pan/zoom in dagState{frontier,focus}, chipHTML(t) shared chip. Verified: node --check OK; live run selects 31/296 nodes (7 seeds all included, 141 hidden, 124 orphans); daemon serves new HTML per-request.
